Markdown reads a number closed by ')' as an ordered item, as markdown-it does (rich-unfiled-791c.zhwr) (#443)

* Markdown reads a number closed by ')' as an ordered item, as markdown-it does (rich-unfiled-791c.zhwr)

An item start now carries markdown-it's marker character — the bullet, or
a number's delimiter — and two items share a list when it matches, so a
'.' list and a ')' list split as a '-' list and a '*' list do.

* ItemStart's marker is CommonMark's two kinds, so a bullet cannot carry a number; nested and quoted delimiter changes pinned (rich-unfiled-791c.zhwr review)
